Dermalogica's Virtual Assistant · AI says:
We accept returns for any Dermalogica.com purchase for any reason.
Timing: Start your return within 30 days of your order date to be eligible for a refund.
Condition: Items must be new or gently used and in original packaging. Damaged, nearly empty, or tampered items are not refundable.
How to return:
Go to our online returns center and enter your order number (begins with S) and shipping ZIP code.
Select the items to return, confirm details, and print the prepaid UPS shipping label.
Repack the items, include the packing slip, affix the label, and drop off at a UPS store.
Once we receive your package, we’ll process your refund or replacement.
Fees: There are no return shipping, handling, or restocking fees when you follow our return process.
Refund eligibility: Only returns that can be traced back to our warehouse using our prepaid label are eligible for a refund.
Final sale / non-returnable: Partial kits or gift sets, free samples, gifts with purchase, and rewards items cannot be refunded.
Afterpay or Klarna: Returns follow our standard policy; you can also review Afterpay’s or Klarna’s own return/refund policy on their sites.
If you don’t want your order: If an order has already processed and cannot be canceled, you can still use our online return center for a full refund of all returned items.
Points and rewards: If you return a product or an order is canceled, the points and any tier level gained from that purchase will be reversed or adjusted accordingly.
What is your return policy?
